ἐκ-ταράσσω [in LXX: [[psalms 18 4|Psa.18:4]] (עֵת pi.), [[psalms 88 16|Psa.88:16]] (צוּם), צוּם), Wis.17:3-4 18:17 * ;] to throw into great trouble, agitate: [[acts 16 20|Act.16:20.]]† (AS)

ἐκ-τείνω [in LXX for שָׁלַח, נָטָה, etc. ;] to stretch out or forth: τ. χεῖρα (as often in LXX), [[matthew 8 3|Mat.8:3 12:13 14:31 26:51]], [[mark 1 41|Mrk.1:41 3:5]], [[luke 5 13|Luk.5:13 6:10]] [[john 21 18|Jhn.21:18]], [[acts 26 1|Act.26:1]]; before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), towards, [[matthew 12 49|Mat.12:49;]] against, [[luke 22 53|Luk.22:53;]] εἰς ἴασιν, [[acts 4 30|Act.4:30;]] of anchors, to cast, [[acts 27 30|Act.27:30.]]† (AS)

1. outside , opposite to ἐντός: 2. as preposition with genitive outside, out of, far from , with genitive, (Homer): outside of, free from , (Herdotus Historicus), attic; ἐκτὸς ἐλπίδος beyond hope, Lat. praeter spem, (Sophocles Tragicus) 3. of Time, beyond , (Herdotus Historicus) 4. except , ἐκτὸς ὀλίγων (Xenophon Historicus) 5. absolute, τὰ ἐκτός external things , (Euripides) 6. with Verbs of motion, ῥίπτειν ἐκτός to throw out , (Sophocles Tragicus), etc. (ML)

ἔλεγχος, -ου, ὁ (ἐλέγχω) [in LXX: frequently in Pr, Jb (יָכַח) יָכַח) Wis.5:1-23, Sir.3:1-31, etc. ;] a proof, test: [[hebrews 11 1|Heb.11:1.]]† (AS)

AR on [[ephesians 5 11|Eph.5:11;]] MM, Exp., xii; cf. ἐξ-, δια-κατ-ελέγχομαι).† SYN.: ἐπιτιμῶ, expressing simply rebuke, which may be un­deserved ([[matthew 16 22|Mat.16:22]]) or ineffectual ([[luke 23 40|Luk.23:40]]), while ἐλ. implies rebuke which brings conviction (see Tr., Syn., § iv) (AS)
ἐλεεινός, -ή, -όν (ἔλεος in Re, l.with, WH have the Attic poëtic form, ἐλεινός), pitiable, miserable: [[revelation 3 17|Rev.3:17;]] comparat., [[1-corinthians 15 19|1Co.15:19.]]† (AS)

ἐλεέω (in [[romans 9 16|Rom.9:16]], Ju 22, -άω, which see), -ῶ (ἔλεος), [in LXX (Hex, Pss, Pr) chiefly for חָנַן, also frequently in Proph. for רָחַם, etc. ;] to have pity or mercy on, to show mercy: absol., [[romans 9 16|Rom.9:16 12:8]]; with accusative, [[matthew 9 27|Mat.9:27 15:22 17:15 18:33 20:30-31]], [[mark 5 19|Mrk.5:19 10:47-48]], [[luke 16 24|Luk.16:24 17:13 18:38-39]] [[romans 9 15|Rom.9:15, 18 11:32]], [[philippians 2 27|Php.2:27]], Ju 22. Pass., to have pity or mercy shown one (EV, obtain mercy): [[matthew 5 7|Mat.5:7]], [[romans 11 30|Rom.11:30-31]], [[1-corinthians 7 25|1Co.7:25]], [[2-corinthians 4 1|2Co.4:1]], [[1-timothy 1 13|1Ti.1:13 1:16]], [[1-peter 2 10|1Pe.2:10]].† (AS)

ἐλεημοσύνη, -ης, ἡ (ἐλεέω), [in LXX chiefly for חֶסֶד, צְדָקָה ;] 1. mercy, pity. 2. almsgiving, alms (like the German Almosen, a corruption of the Greek word ἐ): [[matthew 6 4|Mat.6:4;]] ποιεῖν ἐ., [[matthew 6 2|Mat.6:2-3]], [[acts 9 36|Act.9:36 10:2 24:17]]; ἐ. διδόναι, [[luke 11 41|Luk.11:41]] (cf. [[matthew 23 36|Mat.23:36;]] Dalman, Words, 62 f.) 12:33; αἰτεῖν, [[acts 3 2|Act.3:2;]] λαβεῖν, [[acts 3 3|Act.3:3;]] πρὸς (in order to ask) ἐ., [[acts 3 10|Act.3:10;]] pl., [[acts 10 4|Act.10:4, 31]] (Cremer, 711).† (AS)
ἐλεήμων, -ον [in LXX chiefly for חַנּוּן ;] merciful: [[matthew 5 7|Mat.5:7]], [[hebrews 2 17|Heb.2:17]].† (AS)

ἔλεος, -ους, τό (cl. -ου, ὁ, and so Rec., [[matthew 9 13|Mat.9:13 12:7 23:23]], [[titus 3 5|Tit.3:5]], [[hebrews 4 16|Heb.4:16]]; on the Hellenistic form τό ἔ., see WH, App., 158; M, Pr., 60; Mayser, 277; Kühner, i, 515), [in LXX chiefly for חֶסֶד ;] mercy, pity, compassion; 1. of men: [[matthew 9 13|Mat.9:13]] (LXX) [[matthew 12 7|Mat.12:7 23:23]]; ποιεῖν ἔ. (and id. before μετά, with genitive; cf. Heb. עִם חֶסֶד עָשָׂה, [[genesis 21 23|Gen.21:23]], al.), [[luke 10 37|Luk.10:37]], [[james 2 13|Jas.2:13 3:17]]. 2. Of God: [[luke 1 50|Luk.1:50, 54 1:58]], [[romans 15 9|Rom.15:9]], [[ephesians 2 4|Eph.2:4]], [[2-timothy 1 16|2Ti.1:16 1:18]], [[titus 3 5|Tit.3:5]], [[hebrews 4 16|Heb.4:16]], [[1-peter 1 3|1Pe.1:3]]; esp. in benedictions, [[galatians 6 16|Gal.6:16]], [[1-timothy 1 2|1Ti.1:2]], [[2-timothy 1 2|2Ti.1:2]], 2Jn.3, Ju 2; σκευὴ ἐλέους, [[romans 9 23|Rom.9:23;]] σπλάγχνα ἐλέους, [[luke 1 78|Luk.1:78;]] ποιεῖν ἔ. (see supr.), [[luke 1 72|Luk.1:72;]] τ. ὑμετέρῳ ἐλέει, [[romans 11 31|Rom.11:31.]] 3. Of Christ: Ju 21.† SYN.: οἰκτιρμός (see: ἐλεέω) (AS)

ἐλευθερία, -ας, ἡ [in LXX: [[leviticus 19 20|Lev.19:20]] (חֻפְשָׁה), 1Es.4:49 [[esther 4 53|Est.4:53]], Sir.7:21, Sir.33:25, 1Ma.14:27, 3Ma.3:28 * ;] liberty: with reference to the religious life, [[1-corinthians 10 29|1Co.10:29]], [[2-corinthians 3 17|2Co.3:17]], [[galatians 2 4|Gal.2:4 5:1]], [[1-peter 2 16|1Pe.2:16]], [[2-peter 2 19|2Pe.2:19]]; ὁ νόμος τῆς ἐ., [[james 1 25|Jas.1:25 2:12]]; ἡ ἐ. τῆς δόξης, [[romans 8 21|Rom.8:21;]] ἐπ᾽ ἐ., [[galatians 5 13|Gal.5:13]] (on which formula, cf. Deiss., LAE, 327 ff.; Cremer, 251).† (AS)

ἐλεύθερος, -α, -ον [in LXX chiefly for חׇפְשִׁי ;] free; (a) in civil sense, not a slave: [[john 8 33|Jhn.8:33]], [[1-corinthians 7 21|1Co.7:21-22 12:13]], [[galatians 3 28|Gal.3:28]], [[ephesians 6 8|Eph.6:8]], [[colossians 3 11|Col.3:11]], [[revelation 6 15|Rev.6:15 13:16 19:18]]; fem., [[galatians 4 22|Gal.4:22-23, 30]]; (b) as regards restraint and obligation in general: [[matthew 17 26|Mat.17:26]], [[1-corinthians 9 1|1Co.9:1]]; before ἐκ, [[1-corinthians 9 19|1Co.9:19;]] ἀπό, [[romans 7 3|Rom.7:3;]] with inf., [[1-corinthians 7 39|1Co.7:39;]] from the law, [[galatians 4 26|Gal.4:26]], [[1-peter 2 16|1Pe.2:16]]; from sin, [[john 8 32|Jhn.8:32, 36]]; τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ, as regards righteousness, [[romans 6 20|Rom.6:20]] (Cremer, 249).† (AS)

ἐλευθερόω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[proverbs 25 10|Pro.25:10.]] 2Ma.1:27 2Mac 2:22 * ;] to make free from sin, [[john 8 32|Jhn.8:32, 36]]; before ἀπό, [[romans 6 18|Rom.6:18, 22 8:2, 21]]; τ. ἐλευθερία (dative commodi), [[galatians 5 1|Gal.5:1]] (on the "punctiliar" force of this verb, see M, Pr. 149; cf. also Cremer, 251).† (AS)
a coming:—;the Advent of our LORD, (New Testament) (ML)
ἐλεφάντινος, -η, -ον (ἐλέφας, ivory), [in LXX for שֵׁן ;] of ivory: [[revelation 18 12|Rev.18:12.]]† (AS)
Ἐλιακείμ(Heb. אֶלְיָקִים), Eliakim, an ancestor of Jesus: [[matthew 1 13|Mat.1:13]], [[luke 3 30|Luk.3:30]].† (AS)
Ἐλιακείμ(Heb. אֶלְיָקִים), Eliakim, an ancestor of Jesus: [[matthew 1 13|Mat.1:13]], [[luke 3 30|Luk.3:30]].† (AS)
Ἐλιέζερ(Heb. אֱלִיעֶזֶר), ὁ, indecl., Eliezer, an ancestor of Jesus: [[luke 3 29|Luk.3:29.]]† (AS)
Ἐλιούδ, ὁ indecl., Eliud, an ancestor of Jesus: [[matthew 1 14|Mat.1:14-15.]]† (AS)
Ἐλεισάβετ (T, Rec. Ἐλισ-; see WH, App., 155), ἡ indecl. (Heb. אֱלִישֶׁבַע) Elizabeth: [[luke 1 5|Luk.1:5]] ff.† (AS)
Ἐλισαῖος (Rec. Ἐλισσαῖος; Τ, Ἑλισ-), -ου, ὁ (Heb. אֱלִישָׁע), Elisha, the prophet: [[luke 4 27|Luk.4:27.]]† (AS)
ἑλίσσω [in LXX: [[isaiah 34 4|Isa.34:4]] (גָּלַל ni.), [[psalms 102 26|Psa.102:26]] (חָלַף hi.), etc. ;] to roll, roll up: [[hebrews 1 12|Heb.1:12]] (LXX), [[revelation 6 14|Rev.6:14.]]† (AS)

ἑλκος, -εος (-ους), τό [in LXX: [[exodus 9 9|Exo.9:9-11]], [[leviticus 13 18|Lev.13:18-27]], [[2-kings 20 7|4Ki.20:7]], [[job 2 7|Job.2:7]] (שְׁחִין) ;] 1. a wound (Hom.). 2. a sore, an ulcer (Thuc., al.): [[luke 16 21|Luk.16:21]], [[revelation 16 2|Rev.16:2, 11]].† (AS)
ἑλκόω, -ῶ 1. to wound. 2. to ulcerate; pass., to suffer from sores: pf. ptcp., εἱλκωμίνος (Rec. ἡλκ-), EV, full of sores, [[luke 16 20|Luk.16:20.]]† (AS)

ἕλκω (Hellenistic form ἑλκύω in [[john 11 1|Jhn.11:1-57.]] with, [[acts 16 19|Act.16:19]]), [in LXX for מָשַׁךְ, etc. ;] to draw: with accusative of thing(s), [[john 18 10|Jhn.18:10 21:6]]; with accusative of person(s), before ἔξω, [[acts 21 30|Act.21:30;]] εἰς, [[acts 16 19|Act.16:19]], [[james 2 6|Jas.2:6]]. Metaphorical, to draw, lead, impel: [[john 6 44|Jhn.6:44 12:32]]. (For discussion of ἕ. in Oxyrh. Log., see Deiss., LAE, 437 ff.)† (AS)

Ἑλλάς, -άδος, ἡ [in LXX: [[isaiah 66 19|Isa.66:19]], [[ezekiel 27 13|Eze.27:13]] (יָוָן), 1Ma.1:1 1Mac 8:9 * ;] with varying usage as to geographical limits; in NT = 'Αχαία (cf. [[acts 18 12|Act.18:12]]), Greece: [[acts 20 2|Act.20:2.]]† (AS)

Ἕλλην, -ηνος, ὁ [in LXX: [[joel 3 6|Jol.3:6]], [[zechariah 9 13|Zec.9:13]] (יָוָן), etc.; 1Ma.1:19, al. * ;] a Greek; opposite to βάρβαρος, [[romans 1 14|Rom.1:14;]] usually in ΝΤ of Greek Gentiles, opposite to Ἰουδαῖοι: [[john 7 35|Jhn.7:35]], [[acts 11 29|Act.11:29 14:1 16:1, 3 18:4 19:19, 17 20:21 21:28]] [[romans 1 16|Rom.1:16 2:9-10 3:9 10:12]], [[1-corinthians 1 22|1Co.1:22 1:24 10:32 12:13]], [[galatians 2 3|Gal.2:3 3:28]], [[colossians 3 11|Col.3:11]]; of proselytes, [[john 12 29|Jhn.12:29]], [[acts 17 4|Act.17:4]].† (AS)

Ἑλληνικκός, -ή, -όν [in LXX: [[jeremiah 46 6|Jer.46:6 50:16]] (יָנָה: aliter in Heb.), 2Ma.4:10 2Mac 4:15 2Mac 6:9 2Mac 11:24 2Mac 13:2, 4Ma.8:8 * ;] Greek: τ. Ἑλληνικῇ (sc. γλωσσῇ), [[revelation 9 11|Rev.9:11.]]† (AS)
Ἑλληνίς [in LXX: 2Ma.6:8 A * ;] a Greek (i.e. Gentile) woman: [[mark 7 26|Mrk.7:26]], [[acts 17 12|Act.17:12]].† (AS)
Ἑλληνιστής, -οῦ, ὁ (Ἑλληνίζω, to Hellenize, affect Greek cus­toms), a Hellenist (RV, Grecian Jew): [[acts 6 1|Act.6:1 9:29 11:20]].† (AS)
Ἑλληνιστί adv., in Greek: [[john 19 20|Jhn.19:20;]] Ἑ. (sc. λαλεῖν) γινώσκεις, [[acts 21 37|Act.21:37]] (cf. Field, Notes, 135).† (AS)

ἐλλογάω, -ῶ (a κοινή word, elsewhere usually -έω; cf. Bl., § 22, 2), to charge to one's account, impute: Phm 18 (on parallels, cf. Deiss., LAE, 79 f., 335 f.; Milligan, NTD, 73; MM, Exp., xii); of sin, [[romans 5 13|Rom.5:13]] (Cremer, 400).† (AS)
Ἐλμαδάμ (L, Ἑλ-; Rec. -μωδάμ), ό, indecl., Elmadam, an ancestor of Jesus: [[luke 3 28|Luk.3:28.]] (AS)

ἐλπίζω [in LXX chiefly for בָּטַח, also for חָסָה, יָחַל pi., hi., etc. ;] to look for, expect, hope (for): with accusative of thing(s), [[romans 8 24|Rom.8:24-25]], [[1-corinthians 13 7|1Co.13:7]], [[hebrews 11 1|Heb.11:1]]; with dative of thing(s) (τ. τύχῃ, Thuc., iii, 97, 2), [[matthew 12 21|Mat.12:21;]] before καθώς, [[2-corinthians 8 5|2Co.8:5;]] with inf., [[luke 6 34|Luk.6:34 23:8]], [[acts 26 7|Act.26:7]], [[romans 15 24|Rom.15:24]], [[1-corinthians 16 7|1Co.16:7]], [[2-corinthians 5 11|2Co.5:11]], [[philippians 2 19|Php.2:19, 23]], [[1-timothy 3 14|1Ti.3:14]], II Jn 12, 3Jn.14; before ὅτι, with pres., [[luke 24 21|Luk.24:21;]] with fut., [[acts 24 26|Act.24:26]], [[2-corinthians 1 13|2Co.1:13 13:6]], Phm 22. As in LXX (WM, § xxxiii, d; and esp. in the pf., Ellic. on [[1-timothy 4 10|1Ti.4:10;]] Bl., § 59, 2), with prep.; εἰς, [[john 5 45|Jhn.5:45]] (see Ellis., l.with), [[1-peter 3 5|1Pe.3:5;]] before ὅτι, [[2-corinthians 1 10|2Co.1:10;]] ἐπί, with dative, [[romans 15 12|Rom.15:12]] (LXX [[1-timothy 4 10|1Ti.4:10 6:17]]; ἐν, [[1-corinthians 15 19|1Co.15:19;]] with accusative, [[1-peter 1 13|1Pe.1:13]] (aor. imper. see Bl., § 58, 2); τ. θεόν, [[1-timothy 5 5|1Ti.5:5]] (of. ἀπ-, προ-ελπίζω, see Cremer, 255).† (AS)

ἐλπίς (ἑλ-, [[romans 8 20|Rom.8:20]], WH, see Bl., § 4, 3; M, Pr., 44), -ίδος, ἡ [in LXX for בָּטַח and its derivatives, תִּקְוָה (frequently in Jb), etc. ;] expectation (in cl., rarely of evil, mostly of good, and so always in NT), hope; 1. of hope in general: [[2-corinthians 1 6|2Co.1:6;]] with genitive obj., [[acts 16 19|Act.16:19;]] art. inf., [[acts 27 20|Act.27:20]], [[1-corinthians 9 10|1Co.9:10]]; παρ᾽ ἐλπίδα, [[romans 4 18|Rom.4:18;]] ἐπ᾽ ἐλπίδι, [[1-corinthians 9 10|1Co.9:10.]] 2. Of religious hope: ἐπ᾽ ἐλπίδι, [[acts 2 26|Act.2:26 26:6]], [[romans 4 18|Rom.4:18 8:20]], [[titus 1 2|Tit.1:2]]; τῇ ἐ. ἐσώθημεν, [[romans 8 24|Rom.8:24;]] κατ᾽ ἐλπίδα ζωῆς αἰωνίου, [[titus 3 7|Tit.3:7;]] of the Messianic hope of Israel, [[acts 23 6|Act.23:6 26:6-7 28:20]]; of Christian hope, [[romans 5 2|Rom.5:2-5 12:12 15:4, 13]], [[1-corinthians 13 13|1Co.13:13]], [[2-thessalonians 2 16|2Th.2:16]], [[hebrews 3 6|Heb.3:6 6:11 7:19 10:23]], [[1-peter 1 3|1Pe.1:3 1:21 3:15]]; with genitive obj., [[romans 5 2|Rom.5:2]], [[colossians 1 27|Col.1:27]], [[1-thessalonians 1 3|1Th.1:3 5:8]], [[titus 1 2|Tit.1:2]]; with genitive of that on which the hope is based, [[acts 26 6|Act.26:6]], [[ephesians 1 18|Eph.1:18 4:4]], [[colossians 1 23|Col.1:23]]; ὁ θεὸς τῆς ἐ., [[romans 15 13|Rom.15:13;]] ἔχειν ἐ. (= cl. ἐλπίζειν), [[acts 24 15|Act.24:15]], [[romans 15 4|Rom.15:4]], [[2-corinthians 3 12|2Co.3:12 10:15]], [[ephesians 2 12|Eph.2:12]], [[1-thessalonians 4 13|1Th.4:13]]; before ἐπί, with dative, [[1-john 3 3|1Jn.3:3;]] εἰς, [[acts 24 15|Act.24:15;]] ὅτι, [[romans 8 20|Rom.8:20]], [[philippians 1 20|Php.1:20-21]]. Meton., (a) of the author or ground of hope (cl.): [[1-thessalonians 2 19|1Th.2:19]], [[1-timothy 1 1|1Ti.1:1]]; with genitive obj., [[colossians 1 27|Col.1:27;]] (b) of the thing hoped for: [[galatians 5 5|Gal.5:5]], [[colossians 1 5|Col.1:5]], [[titus 2 13|Tit.2:13]], [[hebrews 6 18|Heb.6:18]] (Cremer, 252, 712).† (AS)
Ἐλύμας, -α, ὁ (Aram. or Arab., cf. DB, i, 246 b) Elymas: [[acts 13 8|Act.13:8.]]† (AS)
ἐλωί (-ΐ Rec.; ἑλωΐ LT; Aram. אֱלָהּ), Eloi: [[matthew 27 46|Mat.27:46]], [[mark 15 34|Mrk.15:34]]" (LXX) .† (AS)

ἐμαυτοῦ, -ῆς, -oῦ reflex prop. of first of person(s), used only in genitive, dative and accusative sing., of myself: [[luke 7 7|Luk.7:7]], al.; ἀπ᾽ ἐ, [[john 5 30|Jhn.5:30 7:17, 28 8:28, 42 10:18 14:10]]; ὑπ᾽ ἐμαυτόν, [[matthew 8 9|Mat.8:9]], [[luke 7 8|Luk.7:8]] (AS)

ἐμ-βαίνω [in LXX for עָלָה, etc. ;] to step into: [[john 5 4|Jhn.5:4]] (WH, RV omit); εἰς πλοῖον, to embark: [[matthew 8 23|Mat.8:23 9:1 13:2 14:22 15:39]], [[mark 4 1|Mrk.4:1 5:18 6:45 8:10, 13]], [[luke 5 3|Luk.5:3 8:22, 37]], [[john 6 17|Jhn.6:17, 24 21:3]], [[acts 21 6|Act.21:6]].† (AS)
ἐμ-βάλλω [in LXX for שׂוּם, etc. ;] to cast into: before εἰς, [[luke 12 5|Luk.12:5]] (cf. MM, Exp., vii, 93).† (AS)
ἐμ-βάπτω to dip in: τ. χεῖρα ἐν τ. τρυβλίῳ, [[matthew 26 23|Mat.26:23;]] mid., before εἰς, [[mark 14 20|Mrk.14:20.]]† (AS)

ἐμβατεύω [in LXX: with accusative, [[joshua 19 49|Jos.19:49]] (נָחַל, [[joshua 19 51|Jos.19:51]] (חָלַק pi.); before εἰς, 1Ma.12:25 1Mac 13:20 1Mac 14:31 1Mac 15:40; metaphorically, 2Ma.2:30 * ;] (ἐμβάτης ἐμβαίνω) 1. to step in or on (Soph.), hence (a) to frequent, haunt, dwell in (Æsch., Eur.); metaphorically, [[colossians 2 18|Col.2:18]] (dwelling in, R, txt.; taking, R, mg.); (b) to invade (1Mac, ll with; metaphorically, Col, Lc.). 2. to enter on, come into possession of (Eur., Dem.; LXX, Jos, H. with); on the difficulties of reading and interpretation in this passage, see Lft, Col., 194 f., 252; ICC, 268 ff.; Field, Notes, 197; Milligan, NTD, 177; and for exx. from π., MM, Exp., xii (cf. κενεμβ.).† (AS)

ἐμ-βιβάζω [in LXX: [[2-kings 9 23|4Ki.9:23]] (רָכַב hi.), [[proverbs 4 11|Pro.4:11]] (דָּרַךְ hi.) * ;] 1. to set in, put in. 2. to put on board ship, embark: with accusative of person(s), before εἰς, [[acts 27 6|Act.27:6.]]† (AS)

ἐμ-βλέπω [in LXX for רָאָה, [[1-kings 8 8|3Ki.8:8]], al.), פָּנָה ([[job 6 28|Job.6:28]] A, al.); metaphorically, [[isaiah 51 1|Isa.51:1]] (נָבַט hi.), Sir.2:10, etc. ;] to look at: with accusative of thing(s), [[mark 8 25|Mrk.8:25;]] with dative of person(s) (part., before λέγει, εἶπεν, cf. Xen., Cyr., i, 3, 2), [[matthew 19 26|Mat.19:26]], [[mark 10 21|Mrk.10:21, 27 14:67]], [[luke 20 17|Luk.20:17 22:61]] (ἐνέβλεψεν), [[john 1 36|Jhn.1:36, 43]]; absol., to look, [[acts 22 11|Act.22:11;]] metaphorically, to consider: [[matthew 6 26|Mat.6:26.]]† (AS)

ἐμ-βριμάομαι (T, -έομαι; Bl., § 22, 1), -ῶμαι (βρίμη, strength, bulk, whence βριμάομαι, to snort with anger), depon., with aor. mid. and pass., [in LXX (Hatch, Essays, 25): Dan LXX 11:30 (also Aq., [[psalms 7 12|Psa.7:12;]] Sm., [[isaiah 17 13|Isa.17:13]]) * ;] to snort in (of horses, Æsch.), hence, to speak or act with deep feeling (DCG, i, 62b); (a) to be moved with anger (cf. ἐμβρίμημα, [[lamentations 2 6|La 2:6]]): with dative, [[mark 14 5|Mrk.14:5]], [[john 11 33|Jhn.11:33]]; ἐν ἑαυτῷ, [[john 11 38|Jhn.11:38;]] (b) to admonish sternly: with dative, [[matthew 9 30|Mat.9:30]], [[mark 1 43|Mrk.1:43]].† (AS)

ἐγώ, genitive, etc., ἐμοῦ, ἐμοί, ἐμέ (enclitic μου, μοι, με), pl. ἡμεῖς, -ῶν, -ῖν, -ᾶς, of person(s) pron. I. (a) The nom. is usually emphatic, when expressed as subjc, as in [[matthew 3 11|Mat.3:11]], [[mark 1 8|Mrk.1:8]], [[luke 3 16|Luk.3:16]], al. But often there is no apparent emphasis, as [[matthew 10 16|Mat.10:16]], [[john 10 17|Jhn.10:17]]; ἰδοὺ ἐ. (= Heb. הִנֵּנִי, cf. [[1-kings 3 8|1Ki.3:8]]), [[acts 9 10|Act.9:10]]; ἐ. (like Heb. אֲנִי), I am, [[john 1 23|Jhn.1:23]] (LXX), [[acts 7 32|Act.7:32]] (LXX). (b) The enclitic forms (see supr.) are used with nouns, adjectives, verbs, adverbs, where there is no emphasis: ἐν τ. πατρί μου, [[john 14 20|Jhn.14:20;]] μου τ. λόγους, [[matthew 7 24|Mat.7:24;]] ὀπίσω μου, [[matthew 3 11|Mat.3:11;]] ἰσχυρότερός μου, ib.; λέγει μοι, [[revelation 5 5|Rev.5:5;]] also with the prep. πρός, as [[mark 9 19|Mrk.9:19]], al.
